item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 02/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. The trough of low pressure now affecting the northern part of southern China will develop into a cold front and move across the coastal areas on Sunday night to Monday morning. There will be showers and a chance of thunderstorms over the region. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon associated with the cold front, the weather will be slightly cooler over Guangdong in the following couple of days. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will become cold progressively and there will be a few rain patches over the region.
